standalone_integrated_engine.note: Gamma/CLOB/Binance public data to virtual fill and official settlement

book_health_and_recovery.note: Current BTC five-minute markets only; valid two-token snapshots required; stale/empty/crossed books fail closed; per-token failures never reconnect the entire WebSocket; unavailable tokens are pruned; each market receives one persistent final evaluation or explicit rejection

fees_and_sizing.note: Actual frozen policy is unchanged: token-specific fee endpoint, Decimal five-place fees, two-share base target, venue minimum, depth, partial fill and slippage checks

restart_safe_account.note: SQLite WAL, fixed experiment identity, deterministic fill and settlement IDs, deduplication; market/shadow evaluations and shadow settlements are exactly once

risk_controls.note: Actual daily risk includes unresolved cost at worst case; rejected five-share rescue policy cannot place virtual fills

official_settlement.note: Closed UP/DOWN price plus Chainlink/Data Streams/TWAP methodology required for both actual and shadow settlement

shutdown_and_diagnostics.note: SIGINT/SIGTERM, atomic status, fsynced JSONL diagnostics; retry spam replaced by one persistent per-market completion/rejection

public_live_smoke.note: The smoke began in the closing seconds of an old market, persisted its unavailable windows as missed, pruned it at expiry, updated the existing WebSocket subscription in place, immediately obtained valid REST snapshots for both new tokens, and ended with fresh UP/DOWN books and all feeds healthy. No label or evaluation was fabricated.

candidate_grid.selection_control: validation score subtracts a max-selection penalty over the predeclared grid

official_checker.reason: The included checker queried the collection endpoint, which returned no matching slug rows; its UNKNOWN labels were preserved and not converted.

official_v2_crosscheck.label_rule: Existing V2 event endpoint/parser: exactly one closed market, exact 1/0 Up/Down prices, and Chainlink/Data Streams/TWAP methodology
official_v2_crosscheck.cost_assumption: Five shares at the logged ask using inferred_cost_per_share from the overnight evidence, including its logged fee/slippage adjustment

rescue_20261019.rejection_rationale: The post-hoc screen produced only $0.4885 across 17 hypothetical five-share trades, the bootstrap interval spans substantial loss and gain, and market-implied probabilities had slightly lower Brier error. This does not justify raising the actual maximum ask, pair-cost ceiling, or order size.

policies.rescue: Ask 0.10-0.85; pair cost <=1.02; selected probability >=0.65; token-fee-adjusted edge >=0.02; visible best-ask size >=5; target=max(5, venue minimum); <=$6 hypothetical debit

read_only_forward_shadows.execution: No fills and no effect on cash, exposure, daily loss budget, or actual strategy decisions
read_only_forward_shadows.settlement: Official TWAP-consistent V2 label parser; UNKNOWN remains unresolved

limitations: The 122 archived observations and 17 post-hoc rescue candidates are exploratory and too small to establish profitability.
The rescue candidates were selected after observing overnight logs and are not an untouched holdout.

The included official checker could not resolve historical slugs through its collection endpoint; the reported labels come from the existing stricter V2 event endpoint/parser, with raw responses retained.
A live venue minimum above two shares causes the actual frozen policy to fail closed; the two-share risk cap is not relaxed.
Forward 120-second and 60-second shadows require a valid initial snapshot and causal BTC history; missed windows are persisted explicitly rather than imputed.
next_action: Run the unchanged frozen candidate paper-only for 24 hours while collecting the current-versus-rescue 120-second and 60-second shadows; do not interpret this as permission for live-money trading.
